title: 第二十一章 连天大雪山第二十二章 找上来的修士
slug: 种魔得仙第两千三十二章开了

“小子，站住。”
几息之后，高墙声音从后传来，冰冷威严。
赢商继续朝前走去。
高墙旁边的青年，看的顿时不爽起来，冷哼道：“白衣服的小子，我师傅让你停下，听不到吗？想死不成！”
蛮横霸道！
这青年，身材高大，浓眉大眼，但不显得英雄豪迈，反而阴恻恻的仿佛一头凶虎。
赢商认得，是高墙的最看重的徒弟慕容海，和高墙一样，也是冰修，磐气后期的境界。赢商之前，根本瞧不上这样的小子，现在对方呵斥到他头上来了。
……
“二位是喊我？”
赢商转过身来，看向二人，神色拘谨里透着谨慎，还有几分懵，一副小修被大佬莫名盯上后的样子，十分正常。
慕容海冷哼，再不多话，也不知道自己师傅喊对方是要干什么。
而高墙此刻，则是上上下下的打量起赢商。
赢商之前，已经得到宝灵提醒，高墙这个和他有着天道羁绊的老熟人来了，但思索了一下，到底还是没有立刻离开，自信自己掩饰的不错，也试探看看这些熟人们，到底能否看穿自己。此时此刻，把所有的往常神态，都掩饰的干干净净。
“小子，你是谁？哪一家的？”
“在下赵河，一介散修，见过前辈。”
赢商淡然回应，不卑不亢。
高墙再打量了他好一会，终究是一挥手。
赢商转身而去。
身后里，高墙师徒也继续走去，慕容海忍不住问起自己师傅。

“这个小子，让我想起一个老冤家，总觉的他们隐约有三分相似。”
“谁？”
“赢商。”
“那定是师傅看错了，相貌不同不说，境界也完全不符，不对，听说赢商服了毒丹，境界跌落了，这个小子，难道真是那个老狐狸假扮的？他还没死？”
“不可能是赢商。”
高墙摇头笑道：“赢商是个冰修，修真界都知道，而这个小子，是个金修，光这一点，就说不过去。”
慕容海恍然，刚才他都没注意到这点。
“走吧，我们今天在这里休息一晚，明天分道扬镳，你去连天大雪山磨砺，我去极北大冰原。”
“是，师傅。”
另外一边，走去的赢商，眼底冷笑，一闪而过。
进这个坊市之前，他就施展元气转换之法，将一身冰元气，转为了一身金元气，任谁都想不到是他。
这种元气转化，只要会元气转化之法，个个修士，都能做到，但没有对应的灵根之身，会疯狂泄露，身躯锁不住，赢商现在是金冰双灵根之身，当然是完美掩饰。
瞒过高墙，赢商信心大增。
……
转眼就到第二天，赢商一早就出发，赶往连天大雪山。

"Boy, stop."
A few breaths later, the sound of the high wall came from behind, cold and majestic.
Yingshang continued to move forward.
The young man next to the high wall suddenly became unhappy and snorted: "Young man in white clothes, my master told you to stop, don't you hear me? You want to die!"
Arrogant and domineering!
This young man was tall, with thick eyebrows and big eyes, but he did not look heroic and heroic, but instead looked as sinister as a ferocious tiger.
Ying Shang recognized that it was Gao Qiang's most valued disciple Murong Hai. Like Gao Qiang, he was also in the late stage of Bing Xiu and Pan Qi. Before Yingshang, he didn't look down on such a boy at all, but now the other party scolded him.
…
"Are you two calling me?"
Ying Shang turned around and looked at the two of them. His expression was reserved and cautious, but also a bit confused. He looked like Xiao Xiu after being inexplicably targeted by a big boss, which was very normal.
Murong Hai snorted coldly. No matter how much he said, he didn't know what his master was trying to do by calling him.
At this moment, Gao Qiang was looking up and down at the winning quotient.
Before Yingshang had been reminded by Bao Ling, Gao Qiang, an old acquaintance with whom he had ties to heaven, was here, but after thinking about it, he still didn't leave immediately. He was confident that he had concealed it well, and he also tested to see if these acquaintances could see through him. At this moment, all his usual demeanor was completely concealed.
"Boy, who are you? Which family are you from?"
"I am Zhao He, a casual cultivator who has met my senior."
Ying Shang responded calmly, neither humble nor overbearing.
Gao Qiang looked at him for a while and finally waved his hand.
The winning businessman turned around and left.
Behind him, Master Gaoqiang and his apprentice continued to walk, and Murong Hai couldn't help but ask about his master.
"This kid reminds me of an old enemy. I always feel that they are vaguely similar."
"Who?"
"Winning business."
"Then the master must have made a mistake. Not only the appearance is different, but the realm is also completely different. No, I heard that Ying Shang took the poison pill and his realm dropped. Is this kid really the old fox pretending to be? Is he not dead yet?"
"It can't be a winning business."
Gao Qiang shook his head and said with a smile: "Ying Shang is an ice cultivator, and everyone in the cultivation world knows it, but this kid is a gold cultivator. This alone cannot be justified."
Murong Hai suddenly realized that he had not noticed this just now.
"Let's go, let's rest here for one night today, and we'll go our separate ways tomorrow. You go to the snow-capped mountains to hone your skills, and I'll go to the Far North Icefield."
"Yes, master."
On the other side, Ying Shang walked away with a sneer in his eyes.
Before entering this city, he used the method of energy transformation to transform his ice energy into gold energy. No one could have imagined that it was him.
This kind of energy transformation can be done by any monk as long as they know the method of energy transformation, but without the corresponding spiritual root body, it will leak out wildly and the body cannot be locked. Ying Shang now has a body with double spiritual roots of gold and ice, which is of course a perfect cover.
Overcoming the high wall, the confidence of winning business is greatly increased.
…
In the blink of an eye, the next day came. Yingshang set off early in the morning and rushed to the snow-capped mountains.
